result.summary: The main visual issue is a layout alignment problem in the 'Fastest near you' section, where restaurant titles are being cut off by the edge of the card container.

issues.description: The title 'Trattoria Piccol...' is truncated at the edge of the card. While the carousel effect is intentional, the text container for the restaurant names does not appear to have sufficient padding or a responsive layout to accommodate full names.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the text container width or implement an ellipsis approach that allows more room for text, or ensure there is sufficient padding inside the card so the truncation doesn't occur prematurely.
